title: Product Owner - Investments
text: **About GoTyme** The GoTyme Group is one of the world's fastest-growing digital banking groups. We serve over 20 million customers across South Africa, the Philippines and Asia. We lead distribution with a mobile and 'phygital' experience to bring fair, simple banking to people the industry has historically underserved. GoTyme is backed by world-class investors including Nubank, Tencent, Norrsken22, the Gokongwei Group, ARC and others. We are headquartered in Singapore, with our main engineering hub in Vietnam and operating banks in South Africa and the Philippines. **About GoTymeX** GoTymeX is the engineering, product, and design organisation that builds the digital products powering the GoTyme Group. Our product culture is customer-first, data-driven with an emphasis on end-to-end ownership of the customer experience and its success. **About The Product** The Investments and Digital Assets Portfolio is where GoTyme brings wealth-building to customers who have historically been locked out of it. Within it, the Investments pod owns the Group's Digital Assets, and Equities products today, with additional asset classes on the horizon. This team owns the experience that let's a first-time investor buy their first share or their first coin in a few taps, with the safety, transparency and regulatory substance they expect from their bank. The pod operates with the speed of a startup, backed by the resources of a multi-country group. It shares infrastructure with our wider digital-asset portfolio (custody, wallets, ledgering, screening and on-chain settlement), so there is real scope to build once and scale across products and markets. **The Role** We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the Investments pod and own the roadmap and delivery of our trading products. You will sit at the intersection of retail banking, capital markets and crypto, turning complex market and digital-asset mechanics into experiences that feel as simple as the rest of a banking app for a mass-market customer. The role is hands-on. You will own the backlog, write the user stories, run the sprint cadence, drive partner and vendor integrations, and be accountable for what ships and for how it performs after launch. The successful candidate has shipped regulated consumer financial products at the quality bar regulators demand, and is comfortable working across both traditional securities and crypto. **What You Will Do** * Own the product backlog end-to-end: translate the proposition into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise against time-to-market, regulatory constraint and customer value * Own the customer experience across the trading lifecycle for stocks, crypto, and future asset classes: onboarding and suitability, funding, order placement and execution, portfolio and holdings, statements, tax and regulatory reporting, and servicing * Translate between capital markets, crypto and retail banking. Convert market mechanics (order types, market hours, settlement cycles, corporate actions, fractional ownership) and digital-asset mechanics (custody, multi-chain support, screening and Travel Rule, on-chain settlement) into product experiences a first-time investor can use. Equally, translate retail banking expectations (KYC step-up, dispute handling, regulatory reporting, AML monitoring, ledgering) into requirements our brokerage, exchange and infrastructure partners can build against * Drive partner and vendor integration. You will own the product-side relationship with brokers, liquidity providers, custodians and market data providers, treating each partner as part of the user experience rather than a black box behind it * Define and track success: set product KPIs (activation, funded accounts, trading volumes, retention, revenue per user), run experiments and use data to decide what to build next * Work with the wider digital-asset teams to reuse shared infrastructure (custody, wallets, ledgering, screening) and avoid duplicating capability across pods * A global-by-design mindset, the ability to make product, technical and compliance decisions with multi-jurisdiction scalability baked in from day one, avoiding local-first shortcuts that create rework, regulatory exposure or architectural debt as the product expands across markets * Establish an AI-native product practice with modern tooling as the default * Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Legal, Marketing and the existing GoTyme product organisations to deliver a coherent, regulated proposition across multiple jurisdictions **Why join** * A zero-to-one opportunity inside a fast-growing group; the upside of greenfield and the support of an experienced team * Best-in-class partners across the infrastructure stack * Join a company that is scaling globally and responsibly, with access to tier-1 partners and vendors * Compensation aligned to a regulated fintech with quality benefits **Requirements** **Must-have** * 5+ years of product experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with demonstrable end-to-end ownership of consumer-facing products that shipped to production and scaled post-launch to drive revenue * The ability to translate Investment/trading product requirements in to formulas that are ready for our engineering team to pick up and build according to this file * Working knowledge of crypto and digital assets: custody, wallets, exchanges and on-chain mechanics, and how they differ from traditional securities * Hands-on experience launching and scaling traditional asset classes, including stocks, ETFs, funds and commodities, for retail investment businesses, from product design and regulatory alignment through to go-live and growth * Financial services experience. You have shipped regulated retail products, ideally in investing, brokerage, trading, wealth or payments * Hands-on agile product discipline: clear user stories, crisp acceptance criteria, relentless prioritisation, and fluency in Jira, Confluence, or equivalent tools * Multi-vendor orchestration experience, including API-first integration approaches, vendor roadmap and SLA management, and a credible voice in commercial discussions * Technical literacy across the stack. You can review API docs, sketch a sequence diagram, and engage teams with domain expertise across a range of product concepts * Demonstrated ability to monitor and synthesise emerging trends across investing, crypto, blockchain and fintech, with a track record of translating market developments into actionable product decisions * Experience operating inside regulated fintechs, ideally across multiple jurisdictions; comfort working with compliance, risk and regulators * An AI-native operating mode. You use AI tooling as a default, you have shipped with it, and you have an opinion on how it changes product workflow and delivery cadence * A 'build like a founder' approach; start-up or scale-up experience, hands-on with the product, comfortable with ambiguity, and biased to ship * Proactive self-starter who consistently surfaces original ideas and strategic recommendations, rather than waiting for direction, bringing solutions, not just execution **Strong plus** * You have shipped a regulated retail trading, brokerage or crypto exchange product live to customers * Hands-on production experience across one or more of: brokerage and order management systems, market data, custody and settlement, portfolio and ledger management, wallet infrastructure, identity, fraud and risk systems including AML and Travel Rule tooling * Experience in emerging-market or mass-market investing, including onboarding first-time investors and building trust and financial education into the product * Experience with fractional investing, recurring investment plans, or tokenised assets * Experience as one of the founding product hires on a new product or business line * Hands-on experience designing crypto-native financial products such as staking or earn propositions **Benefits** * Competitive base salary aligned to seniority and market * Performance-based bonus * Hybrid or fully remote working, with the requirement to operate in an APAC timezone * Quarterly travel to Ho Chi Minh City (covered by the company, if not full-time in Ho Chi Minh City) for all-hands and team in-person time * Generous annual leave, plus public holidays in your country of residence * A learning and development budget, including paid certifications and conference attendance

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Product Owner (GI products - Financial lines)
outNote: general insurance product design, pricing, underwriting, reinsurance
text: **FIND YOUR 'BETTER' AT Blue Cross** *We don't simply believe in being 'The Best'. We believe in better - because there's no limit to how far 'better' can take us.* *We believe in empowering every one of our people to find their 'better' - in the work they do, the career they build, the life they live and the difference they make. So that together we can support even more people - including our own - to live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.* **If you believe in better, we'd love to hear from you.** **About The Role** To provide strategic and end-to-end leadership in the development and management of assigned general insurance products, ensuring alignment with business growth ambitions and market competitiveness. This role is accountable for driving the full product lifecycle, including product design, reinsurance structuring, and operational workflow development, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, efficient, and customer-centric solutions. The Strategic Product Owner operates with confidence and ambition to shape innovative offerings that meet evolving customer needs while maintaining sound technical and financial discipline. The role requires close collaboration with regulatory authorities and internal governance functions to ensure all products comply with applicable standards, as well as effective engagement with cross-functional stakeholders across underwriting, distribution, marketing, claims, finance, and technology to deliver successful product implementations. With strong project management capabilities, the Product Owner leads complex initiatives with discipline and agility, ensuring timely execution and high-quality outcomes. The role plays a critical part in supporting sustainable corporate growth and strengthening the organisation's market position. **Roles And Responsibilities** * Lead development and revamp of emerging General Insurance products, with a strong focus on financial lines (e.g. D\&O, PI, Cyber, FI risks). * Conduct market analysis, industry trend and competitor review to identify product opportunities and enhance competitiveness. * Design and implement product features, pricing frameworks, and underwriting guidelines, ensuring alignment with business strategy and risk appetite. Ensure profitability and sustainability. * Establish and manage reinsurance arrangements, including both treaty and facultative placements for large or complex risks. * Develop and implement end‑to‑end operational workflows on new products with clear SOPs and service standards. * Ensure all products comply with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards. **Minimum Job Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in insurance or Business Administration field. * Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in product development, underwriting or project management, including at least 5 years in management roles. * Proven track record in driving new product design and operational workflow, preferably financial-line products. * Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. * Excellent communication and analytical skills. * Fluency in English and Chinese. **Others** * You are required to obtain the relevant license(s) if your job involves regulated activities *Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.* *You must provide all requested information, including Personal Data, to be considered for this career opportunity. Failure to provide such information may influence the processing and outcome of your application. You are responsible for ensuring that the information you submit is accurate and up-to-date.*

title: Product Manager - AI Finance App
text: **About Doit** Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone. We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. *In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.* **The Role** We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance App. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. **What You'll Own** * Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. * Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. * Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. * Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. * Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. * Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. * Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. **What We're Looking For** * Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. * Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. * Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. * Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. * Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. * High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. * Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. **The Kind of Builder We Want** * Starts from user problems, not feature lists. * Can make decisions with incomplete information. * Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. * Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. * Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. **This Role Is Not For** * People who only write decks and do not drive execution. * PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. * Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. * People who launch features and then stop caring. * PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. **Location** This role is remote, but candidates must be based in **Hong Kong** . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in**Hong Kong.** **Language** English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. **Interview Process** Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product Manager
text: **About the Company** Our client is building an **AI-powered intelligence layer for construction workflows**, helping construction professionals reduce the time spent interpreting drawings, specifications, requirements, and domain knowledge. The platform uses modern AI to transform how teams check, extract, compare, and produce information across complex, document-heavy construction workflows. **The Role** We're looking for a **high-agency Product Manager** to own products from discovery through customer value. You'll identify important customer problems, develop and validate product theses, work closely with Engineering to build solutions, put products in customers' hands, measure whether they create value, and iterate until customers adopt and pay for them. Your immediate focus will be the company's **Design Compliance \& Studio** product area. This is a hands-on ownership role. You won't simply gather requirements, write specifications, or hand work to Engineering. You'll remain accountable for the quality of the product thinking, pace of execution, and customer outcome. **What You'll Do** **1. Discover Valuable Problems** * Lead customer interviews, workflow observations, and market research. * Understand how customers work today, where time and money are lost, and why problems matter. * Look beyond customer requests to identify the underlying needs. * Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, strategic fit, and commercial potential. **2. Form \& Validate Product Theses** * Turn incomplete and sometimes conflicting information into clear product hypotheses. * Define the target user, current workflow, desired outcome, and how the product can solve the problem better. * Identify the riskiest assumptions and design fast, efficient ways to validate them. * Use prototypes, AI-generated interfaces, demos, and lightweight proofs of concept before committing to full development. **3. Drive the Smallest Valuable Release** * Translate product theses into clear outcomes, scope, and success criteria. * Work closely with Engineering and domain experts to ensure the team understands both the customer context and the reasoning behind product decisions. * Make clear scope trade-offs, remove blockers, and keep teams focused on the smallest release capable of creating or validating customer value. * Get working software into customers' hands early rather than waiting for a perfect launch. **4. Own Outcomes After Launch** * Monitor real-world usage and gather structured customer feedback. * Measure whether products solve the intended problem, drive repeat usage, and create willingness to pay. * Turn customer and product evidence into clear decisions: iterate, expand, reposition, or stop. * Build repeatable products rather than a collection of one-off customer solutions. **How Success Is Measured** The primary metric is **Time to Customer Value** --- how quickly the team moves from identifying a valuable customer problem to delivering something that creates measurable value. Depending on the product stage, success may include: * Time to first usable prototype * Time to first customer use * Adoption and repeat usage * Trial-to-paid conversion * Number of paid customers * Revenue generated **What We're Looking For** * Strong product judgment and the ability to form a clear point of view with incomplete information. * Strong customer discovery skills and genuine interest in understanding how users work. * Ability to turn complex customer and market information into a clear product thesis. * Commercial mindset with a strong focus on customer value and willingness to pay. * Ability to communicate customer context clearly so Engineering teams understand **why** they are building something. * Strong prioritization skills and willingness to make aggressive scope trade-offs. * Preference for rapid prototyping and experimentation over lengthy requirements documentation. * Comfortable working with short iteration cycles and moving quickly from idea to validation. * Strong ownership beyond launch, with a focus on adoption and measurable customer outcomes. * Comfortable challenging founders, customers, and Engineering teams when necessary. * Strong understanding of modern AI capabilities and how they are changing what is possible in product development. * Conversant with **LLMs, AI agents, RAG, multimodal models, evaluations, and emerging AI product patterns**. * Able to work effectively with technical teams without necessarily building the underlying AI models yourself. **Bonus Points** * Experience shipping **AI-powered products**. * Comfortable using AI coding tools or a CLI to prototype ideas. * Ability to turn an idea into a rough working demo without waiting for Engineering. * Experience building complex **B2B or enterprise products**. * Experience with document-heavy professional workflows. * Background in **construction, architecture, engineering, or related industries**. **This Role May Not Be for You If** * You view Product Management primarily as gathering requirements and translating them into tickets. * You measure progress mainly through backlog completion or feature volume. * You need everything fully defined before starting. * You default to building whatever customers request without challenging the underlying problem. * You hand requirements to Engineering and move on to the next task. * You consider the job finished once the product launches.

title: Principal / Senior Product Manager, Asset (Tax Reporting, Client Statements & Portfolio)
text: **Who We Are** At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: *We Before Me* , *Do the Right Thing* , and *Get Things Done* . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. **About The Opportunity** The Asset Team is responsible for delivering transparent and reliable asset management experiences across crypto fund movements, portfolio visibility, transaction history and tax reporting. This role will establish a scalable product framework that supports tax reports and statements for users across different jurisdictions, based on applicable regulatory requirements and customer jurisdiction, address and tax-residency information. **What You'll Be Doing** * Define the long-term vision, strategy and roadmap for customer tax reporting, client statements and transaction history. * Establish a scalable global tax reporting platform and expansion framework, enabling new markets and reporting requirements to be supported efficiently. * Partner with Tax, Legal and Compliance teams to assess regulatory developments, determine product impact and prioritize regional initiatives based on regulatory risk, customer needs and business strategy. * Own the development of the Tax Center, including tax documents, reporting status, transaction。 * Lead integrations and product strategy for tax and reporting providers such as TaxBit and Sovos. * Depending on the candidate's experience, contribute to portfolio management and asset analytics products, including asset dashboards, portfolio performance, asset allocation and P\&L experiences. **What We Look For In You** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, engineering, fintech, business). * Prior working experience in well-known Internet/cryptocurrency companies such as Futu, Tiger, Coinbase, etc. preferably in brokerage, tax technology * Ability to translate tax, regulatory and financial requirements into scalable product capabilities, workflows and data requirements. * Experience with digital asset tax reporting, cost basis, gains and losses calculations, tax forms or e-invoicing. * Rigorous, detail-oriented, and composed under pressure. High sense of ownership and accountability. * Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions and prioritize competing demands. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders. * Proficiency in English as it can be used as a working language, Mandarin speaking will be mandatory. **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive total compensation package * L\&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development * Various team building programs and company events * Wellness and meal allowances * Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants * More that we love to tell you along the process! **Notice** All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. **If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.** Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
